title: Warlocks
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The warlocks are the hostile mages: the five-school ladder, the bosses, the witches and the named mages, vanilla, DLC and CC. Their lists are borrowed by records filed elsewhere (the Vaermina Devotees, the Soul Cairn mage souls, Nimphaneth and Sanyon, the CW siege mages and more): each list row on a family page links to every record that draws it, under *Drawn elsewhere*. One runtime injector touches the necromancer lists: `ccVSVSSE003_MainQuest` (Necromantic Grimoire, ccvsvsse003-necroarts.esl) holds its 22 boss leaves `ccVSVSSE003_EncWarlockNecro0{2–6}Boss{Breton,HighElf}{F,M}` and `…Necro07{BretonF,HighElfM}`, the lists `LCharWarlock0{2–6}BossNecro`, `LCharWarlock0{3–6}Necro`, `LCharWarlock07Necro`, `LCharWarlockBossNecro{Female,Male}Condescending` and `LCharWarlockNecroBossMaleElfHaughty`, and its robe and spell-tome lists, and adds its leaves to the necromancer lists at runtime; which leaf goes into which list is in the script `[unverified]`.

sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-02)
sweep.text: Every `LVLN` whose EditorID starts `LCharWarlock`, `LCharWitch` or `SubCharWarlock`, plus `WEAdventurerRangedConjurerSubChar` and `dunFellglow_LCharWarlockPetForScene` (129), and everything they draw; every NPC in `WarlockFaction` 026724, `NecromancerFaction` 034B74 or `WE20WarlockFaction` 09F816, or whose EditorID holds Warlock, Necro, Conjurer or Witch (draugr, Dremora and skeleton records excluded); every record that takes a template from any of them (694 records); every placed reference in the 189 cells and worldspaces that place one. No plugin overrides a warlock `LVLN`. Everything found is on a family page except the following.
